ex.en: The tsar ruled Russia before the revolution.
ex.zh: 沙皇在革命之前統治俄國。

ex.en: A portrait of the last tsar hangs in the museum.
ex.zh: 最後一位沙皇的肖像掛在博物館裡。

ex.en: A tsunami warning was sent to people living near the coast.
ex.zh: 沿海居民收到了海嘯警報。

ex.en: The tsunami was caused by a strong earthquake under the sea.
ex.zh: 這場海嘯是由海底的強震引起的。

tsarist.zh: 沙皇的；沙皇統治時期的

ex.en: The novel is set in tsarist Russia.
ex.zh: 這本小說的背景是沙皇統治下的俄國。
沙皇政府在 1917 年終結。
